_about: v34: report limits per payment plan. reports_per_month = reports a business may create per calendar month (its own time zone; null = no limit). keep_per_user = how many of a person's created reports are kept in 'My reports' (oldest removed first). mails_per_month (v45) = report mails a business may send per calendar month (null = no limit). A business's plan is 'plan' in tenants.json (default_plan when missing). v41: ai_reports_per_month = how many of them get the AI-written story (null = all); when used up, reports are created with the standard texts and a note; a report whose AI writing failed is not counted. Counting rules: see README 'New in v34'. Validate with: python tools/check_report_blocks.py
